info.name: Skilljar Assets VILT > Session Events API

params.name: ends_at__lte
params.description: Filter where a ViltSessionEvent is less than or equal to the ends at value. Datetime format

params.name: page
params.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: session__lesson__course__id
params.description: Filter ViltSessionEvents by exact match of a Course ID

params.name: session__lesson__id
params.description: Filter ViltSessionEvents by exact match of a Lesson ID

params.name: starts_at__gte
params.description: Filter where a ViltSessionEvent is greater than or equal to the starts at value. Datetime format

items.docs:
Retrieve a paginated list of VILT session events.

Returns a list of session events matching the provided filters.
Supports filtering by course, lesson, and date/time.
Retrieve details for a specific VILT session event.
